history.title: Army of Bombay → Hyderabad: catastrophic failure; 1 officer losses.
history.report:
13 dice after 1 defence. Committed: 12 regiments, 2 officers; alliances: none.

Exhaust 12 regiments, 2 officers and 0 local alliances. Return 1 lost officers to their players’ supplies. Never remove regiments for this loss check.

First return half the Commander’s trophies, rounded up, to supply. Return the Commander to their player’s supply. Flip the office card into Vacant Offices and return its fatigue. This office takes no further actions this turn.

Region control, orders, unrest and Elephant position stay as they were.

lines.text: The Company deployment in Hyderabad ended in catastrophic failure; 1 officer loss was reported.
lines.speaker: Chronicler

lines.text: The expedition has failed to change the position in Hyderabad. We shall not mistake that for a permanent settlement.
lines.speaker: Qasim of Hyderabad

lines.text: The expedition has failed. A shorter report would not improve its outcome.
lines.speaker: Thomas Reed

history.title: Manual event test · Foreign Invasion
history.report:
Foreign invasion of Bombay: saved invasion die 5.

Bombay attack: 5 base + 0 unrest × 1 = 5. Exhaust available Army strength 0; insufficient defence.

Bombay is lost. Army of Bombay: if the Commander office is occupied, return half that family’s trophies (round up) and remove the Commander; roll one die per officer in the Army and remove each officer rolling 6.

Officer rout · Bombay · Army of Bombay: 2 officers removed (reported from the table).

Remove any unfinished Company ship; return Bombay’s control token to the region loot-side facedown. Lower Company Standing by 1 spaces for this turn’s 1st region loss.

Restore Bombay’s dome with one tower level.

Bombay is sovereign. Remove its former allegiance flag and set its tower to 2, half the original invasion die rounded down.

Close Bombay £3 (northern). Return any writer there to its owner; flip any filled-order token.

Close Bombay £3 (middle). Return any writer there to its owner; flip any filled-order token.

Close Bombay £4 (southern). Return any writer there to its owner; flip any filled-order token.

Foreign invasion of Madras: saved invasion die 4.

Madras attack: 4 base + 0 unrest × 1 = 4. Exhaust available Army strength 0; insufficient defence.

Madras is lost. Army of Madras: if the Commander office is occupied, return half that family’s trophies (round up) and remove the Commander; roll one die per officer in the Army and remove each officer rolling 6.

Officer rout · Madras · Army of Madras: 0 officers removed (reported from the table).

Remove any unfinished Company ship; return Madras’s control token to the region loot-side facedown. Lower Company Standing by 2 spaces for this turn’s 2nd region loss.

Restore Madras’s dome with one tower level.

Madras is sovereign. Remove its former allegiance flag and set its tower to 2, half the original invasion die rounded down.

Close Madras £5 (northern). Return any writer there to its owner; flip any filled-order token.

Foreign invasion of Bengal: saved invasion die 3.

Bengal attack: 3 base + 0 unrest × 1 = 3. Exhaust available Army strength 0; insufficient defence.

Bengal is lost. Army of Bengal: if the Commander office is occupied, return half that family’s trophies (round up) and remove the Commander; roll one die per officer in the Army and remove each officer rolling 6.

Officer rout · Bengal · Army of Bengal: 1 officer removed (reported from the table).

Remove any unfinished Company ship; return Bengal’s control token to the region loot-side facedown. Lower Company Standing by 3 spaces for this turn’s 3rd region loss.

Restore Bengal’s dome with one tower level.

Bengal is sovereign. Remove its former allegiance flag and set its tower to 1, half the original invasion die rounded down.

Bengal Cascades along its trade routes.

Close Maratha £4 (northern). Return any writer there to its owner; flip any filled-order token.

Close Maratha £2 (southern). Return any writer there to its owner; flip any filled-order token.

All Foreign Invasions are resolved. Now resolve one set of additional rebellions in the remaining Company regions with unrest, in Presidency order. Armies do not refresh.

Manual test: the digital event stack and phase event count are unchanged. Use Undo to reverse this test’s board effects.

lines.text: The Company lost Bombay. The reported officer rout removed 2; removal does not establish death. A foreign force won the attack on Bombay. The Company lost Madras. The reported officer rout removed 0; removal does not establish death. A foreign force won the attack on Madras. The Company lost Bengal. The reported officer rout removed 1; removal does not establish death. A foreign force won the attack on Bengal.
